Title: Flesh for a Whole Month
Promise: God instructed Moses to tell the complaining people they would receive meat every day for a full month, until the supply itself became repulsive to them. Doubt: The provision is explicitly punitive, given in anger at the people's weeping and contempt, and ends in loathing and plague; it is doubtful whether a judgment-provision of this kind belongs in a collection of God's promises.
